title: Four stray run registrations from pre-fix cli test runs remain in the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry, pointing at deleted temp dirs
body: The tick's fix stops NEW strays but cannot clean machine state outside the repo: the operator's registry still holds r-status.json, r-1.json, epic-rmod.json and epic-run.json (r-sigterm.json, a fifth at attempt 17, is no longer present), each pointing at a temp checkout that no longer exists. 9oo's cross-checkout refusal reads a registration back on every claim of those run ids; a deleted dir probes not_running so the refusal does not fire today, but the strays remain enumerable noise for every listing that reads the machine's registrations. Removing them is an operator-machine action (rm of files in ~/.ticfac/registry), not a repo change. Repeated from attempt 17 with the count updated; deduplicates against it.
triaged_by: claude (operator-delegated): stale test registrations removed by hand; eih's own fix stops the tests writing them
